thread:
Jia (CS): weekly cache+batch check for PrismCorp. Short: hit rate down, spend up after team onboarding. Need quick mitigation plan.
Noah (Solutions): quick metrics last 7d: hit_rate=40% (-6ppt), avg_batch_size=2.6 (-0.7), cost_per_1k=$0.97 (+20%), p95_latency=280ms (+50ms).
Arun (Eng): saw recent change: global cache TTL reduced from 8m->3m two days ago to relieve OOM. That likely caused drop.
Jia (CS): Prism uses many repeated short prompts (status pings) so TTL matters. Lena: they surfaced cost concern during renewal prep.
Lena (Acct): renewal in 2 weeks. If we can't show cost controls, they may cut usage. Any quick wins?
Noah (Solutions): propose: 1) route-specific TTL overrides for frequent short routes (5m->12m), 2) enable short-window batching (max_wait_ms=50) for small requests, 3) temporary usage credit. Recommend (1) then (2) canary.
Arun (Eng): agree. low-risk TTL override first. I can add flags: `prism_ttl_override=12m` and `prism_batch_window=50ms`. Will require dashboard annotation.
cs-automation: Feature flag `prism_ttl_override` rolled to 20% at 1800123456. Alerts: hit_rate change > 3ppt OR p95_latency > 350ms.
Noah (Solutions): back-of-envelope: tokens/day 10M. If hit +7ppt and batch +0.5, expected saving ~8%. Will put numbers in renewal note.
Arun (Eng): 2h check: hit_rate=46% (+6ppt), avg_batch_size=3.1 (+0.5), p95_latency=265ms. No error spike.
Jia (CS): great quick win. Noah please add slide with conservative 5% savings and plan for adaptive batcher follow-up. Lena I'll send to customer. Closing actions: monitor 24h and promote flags if stable. :thumbsup:
